description: This Java file defines an immutable class `ImmutablePolicyRevision` that implements the `PolicyRevision` interface. It handles revision values as immutable long integers, providing comparison and increment operations relevant to policy revision management.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyRevision
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the PolicyRevision interface, encapsulating a revision number with comparison and utility methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutablePolicyRevision with the specified value.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than another policy revision.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than or equal to another policy revision.

methods.name: isLowerThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than another policy revision.

methods.name: isLowerThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than or equal to another policy revision.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Returns a new PolicyRevision instance with the value incremented by one.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Returns the long value representing the revision.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the revision value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the revision value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the revision value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this revision with another PolicyRevision object.
